a.xlink:title: Removes the copy and the record. The folder and the lock stay.
Removes the instance folder and releases the lock. Ok when already closed.
Removes the folder of a candidate in any state. Fails when the candidate is in use.
The id of the instance folder; empty while the store is not open.
True while the store holds the lock of its instance folder.
Creates the instance folder with a new random id and locks it. Ok when already open.
root is the folder that holds the instance folders. Nothing is created until open().
True when wroteAll is set and no diagnostic is an error.
The path for a UTF-8 name. Text that cannot be converted as UTF-8 is read in the system code page,...
True when a diagnostic has severity Error.
True when saveScene writes file for scene.
True when name is the name of a file in kSceneFiles.
The scenario of a case that stores none: id "baseline", no incidents and no entrance delays.
Reads the whole file at path into content, byte for byte. Returns false when the file cannot be opene...
Rebuilds loadedData from the model and sourceFiles.
Keeps the directory: the destructor no longer removes it.
